title: Nvidia supplier Wistron launches $700 million Texas factory for AI system production
title_zh: Nvidia 供应商纬创资通 (Wistron) 斥资 7 亿美元在德克萨斯州设立工厂，用于生产人工智能系统
summary: Taiwan's Wistron, a supplier to Nvidia, launched a $700 million ‌manufacturing facility in Texas on Tuesday to ‌produce the U.S. chipmaker's latest AI systems, as Taiwanese electronics ​makers expand U.S. production to meet soaring demand for AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (Nvidia) 的供应商台湾纬创资通 (Wistron) 周二在德克萨斯州启动了一座价值 7 亿美元的制造工厂，用于生产这家美国芯片制造商最新的人工智能系统，同时台湾电子制造商扩大了美国的生产，以满足对人工智能基础设施不断飙升的需求。

title: Stocks jump with chipmakers; oil rises to 5-week high
title_zh: 芯片制造商股价上涨；油价升至5周高点
summary: By Caroline Valetkevitch and Ankur Banerjee NEW YORK/SINGAPORE, July 21 (Reuters) - Major stock indexes rose on Tuesday with the Nasdaq and chipmaker shares surging, while oil prices climbed to a five
summary_zh: 作者：Caroline Valetkevitch 和 Ankur Banerjee 纽约/新加坡，7 月 21 日（路透社）——主要股指周二上涨，纳斯达克和芯片制造商股价飙升，而油价则攀升至 5 点。

title: Supermicro stock jumps on gross margin raise amid record $60 billion backlog
title_zh: Supermicro 股价因毛利率上涨而上涨，积压创纪录的 600 亿美元
summary: Supermicro stock jumped in after-hours trading as the company upped its gross margin guidance amid a record backlog of orders.
summary_zh: 由于订单积压创纪录，超微公司上调了毛利率指引，该公司股价在盘后交易中上涨。

title: Why 1 in 3 investors don't know how their 401k is invested
title_zh: 为什么三分之一的投资者不知道他们的 401k 是如何投资的
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Columnist Kerry Hannon discusses findings from the Schroders 2026 U.S.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级专栏作家 Kerry Hannon 讨论 Schroders 2026 美国的调查结果

title: Google & Tesla kick off Big Tech earnings: What to Watch
title_zh: 谷歌和特斯拉公布大型科技财报：看点
summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Wednesday, Jul. 22, including Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) and Tesla (TSLA) quarterly earnings results.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 仔细研究了 7 月 22 日星期三投资者关注的头条新闻，包括 Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL) 和特斯拉 (TSLA) 的季度盈利结果。

title: Big Tech's big AI spending is 'a good thing' right now
title_zh: 大型科技公司在人工智能方面的巨额支出现在是“一件好事”
summary: The Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) led US stocks (^DJI, ^GSPC) to daily gains on Tuesday as chip stocks began to show signs of recovering from last week's sell-off. Investors' eyes are especially wide on Big Tech earnings expected out this week.
summary_zh: 由于芯片股开始显示出从上周抛售中复苏的迹象，纳斯达克综合指数 (^IXIC) 带领美国股市 (^DJI、^GSPC) 周二上涨。投资者尤其关注本周预计公布的大型科技公司盈利。

title: 3M turns to AI to fuel turnaround
title_zh: 3M 转向人工智能以推动扭亏为盈
summary: Yahoo Finance Ines Ferre joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to discuss the 3M Company (MMM) turnaround after the company beat earnings expectations and raised its full-year outlook.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经 Ines Ferre 与 Josh Lipton 共同探讨了 3M 公司 (MMM) 在超出盈利预期并上调全年预期后的扭亏为盈。

title: GM earnings & outlook impressed, thanks to lower tariffs. But don't get too comfortable.
title_zh: 由于关税降低，通用汽车的盈利和前景令人印象深刻。但不要太舒服。
summary: General Motors (GM) raised its 2026 outlook by $500 million, thanks in part to better margins and lower tariffs. Morning Brief host Julie Hyman discusses more with Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and Payne Capital Management president Ryan Payne.
summary_zh: 通用汽车 (GM) 将 2026 年前景上调了 5 亿美元，部分原因是利润率提高和关税降低。早间简报主持人朱莉·海曼与雅虎财经突发商业新闻记者杰克·康利和佩恩资本管理公司总裁瑞安·佩恩进行了更多讨论。

title: Tesla's jump in sales comes as Optimus, Robotaxi bets require more cash: Q2 earnings preview
title_zh: 特斯拉销量猛增之际，Optimus、Robotaxi 押注需要更多现金：第二季度收益预览
summary: Tesla will report second quarter results after the closing bell on Wednesday. For the first time in a long while, the car business is not the problem, but increased cash burn could be.
summary_zh: 特斯拉将于周三收盘后公布第二季度业绩。很长一段时间以来第一次，汽车业务不是问题，但现金消耗增加可能是问题。
